lines: A raincoat I remember
At the station in the dusk, my heart trembled
That hurried walk — unmistakably
It's him, the man I once loved
Just one step short of nostalgia
Bitter memories welling up
I can't find any words at all
Even without you, I wanted to let you know, just like this,
That I'm living well
Casually, without making it obvious...
What two years have changed
Are his eyes, and this hair of mine
Each of us returning
To the one who waits — neither of us even noticing
He boards the car right next to mine
Watching his face as he looks down,
Tears almost overflow before I know it
Only now do I understand your feelings,
For the first time — it hurts
That you loved me, and me alone
Swallowed up by the rush-hour crowd,
Your figure disappearing from view
Lingers in my heart with such sorrow
By the time I pass through the ticket gate,
The rain has all but stopped, and in this town
An ordinary night is coming on
